title.narrative: COVID-19 vaccination campaign - PEGASE support to the Palestinian Authority to secure COVID-19 vaccines to the Palestinian population in West Bank and Gaza

description.narrative: The EU will support the PA to secure COVID-19 vaccines to the Palestinian population in West Bank and Gaza, aiming to ensure equitable access to vaccines as part of the global efforts to end the pandemic and save lives. In addition, this support will mitigate the impact of the pandemic on Palestinian economy and social life. This activity will consist in reimbursing expenditures incurred by the Ministry of Health for the supply and administration of EMA certified vaccines, in line with the approved vaccination plan.
